messages:
ricardo: Following the postmortem, here's a compact action tracker for streaming/chat reliability. I split items into hotfix, automation, and telemetry. Please add any missing owners.
mei: Thanks. can you drop the hotfix list so i can schedule with infra?
ricardo: Hotfixes: 1) Server read timeout: 28s -> 16s, rollback knob + canary. owner: dennis. due: 2026-03-31. 2) Client-side reconnect policy: add exponential backoff + cap retries at 4. owner: mei. due: 2026-03-27. 3) Stream integrity guard: detect >20% token stream truncation vs expected and trigger model-fallback. owner: anita. due: 2026-04-08. 4) Short-circuit for repeated short reconnects: if same client_id reconnects 6x in 5m, ban for 10m and create ticket. owner: ricardo. due: 2026-03-25.
dennis: I can take #1. will coordinate canary on dedicated and attach rollback steps.
mei: will implement #2. proposal: initial_delay=100ms, multiplier=2, max_delay=3s, max_retries=4. adding jitter 15%.
anita: For fallback logic, we should also emit an event tag `fallback_reason=partial_stream` so downstream billing/qa can filter. adding to my PR notes.
ricardo: Good call. Also want a lightweight SLO dashboard tile: streaming_success_rate (per model pool) and reconnects_per_minute (client_id hotlist). owner: dennis + ops-bot to automate dashboards.
ops-bot: created ticket INC-2026-78 for dashboard tile requests.
mei: small request 1: surface last_stream_byte_time and retry_count in traces so we can distinguish network vs model stalls.
anita: Agree. I'll add trace attributes `last_stream_ts` and `stream_retry_count`.
dennis: Note: two code paths to update (grpc ingress and edge-proxy) and a lambda that normalizes timeout header. I'll open 3 PRs and link.
ricardo: Automation tasks: A) auto-ticket when a client_id hits reconnect threshold (owner: ricardo, due: 2026-03-25). B) nightly job to aggregate seq_len_by_reconnect histogram and post weekly digest to #incidents (owner: mei, due: 2026-04-05).
mei: On digest: will include 95p seq_len and percent reconnects > 1024.
anita: Telemetry: please add metric `partial_stream_rate` and tag by model_variant + pool. owner: anita. due: 2026-04-02.
dennis: Can we also add a rolling alert: if partial_stream_rate > 1% for 10m, page SRE? owner: dennis. due: 2026-04-02.
ricardo: Weekly check-ins on Tuesdays at 9am until items closed. I'll keep this thread as the single source of truth for short updates (PR urls, :thumbsup:, canary start).
oncall-bot: Incident 447 closed. artifacts uploaded to /incidents/447.
mei: PR opened for reconnect middleware: https://git.internal/r/2401 (tests included).
dennis: PR1 (grpc): https://git.internal/r/2402; PR2 (edge-proxy): https://git.internal/r/2403; canary starts 2026-03-24 02:00 UTC.
anita: Draft PR for fallback/circuit: https://git.internal/r/2409. includes telemetry changes.
ricardo: Quick smoke checklist for canary: 1) monitor streaming_success_rate 2) verify read_timeout_triggers zero 3) watch reconnects_per_minute heatmap. ops-bot will create a dashboard snapshot.
ops-bot: dashboard snapshot saved as dash-incident-447-hotfix.
mei: rolled out client reconnect lib to mobile-sdk v1.8.0 (internal pkg). will submit PR to sdk docs.
dennis: Canary report: no regressions on p95 latency after 12h, small bump in reconnects for test clients only. posting logs to the incident folder.
anita: Running evals for partial detection thresholds tonight; will share ROC + chosen threshold in PR.
ricardo: Thanks everyone. If blockers, DM me or mention @oncall-bot. Short updates only in-thread please.
